name: yunari-web
//version: The product's version, and the only place a release writes it (`vg-279`). The workspace's own packages stay 0.0.0 — they are private members of this tree, not released artifacts — so the host CLI and the editor bundle both read this field rather than a copy of it.
description: Frontend workspace: shared renderer, display-only player and editor.

scripts.gate: biome check .. && npm run gates:self-test && npm run docs:check && npm run scratch:check && npm run third-party:check && npm run workflows:check && npm run ffmpeg:check && npm run design:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:worker
scripts.//gate: The one command that means green (D1's ruling, 2026-10-12: biome check, not format:check + lint, because organizeImports is an assist only check runs). `gates:self-test` is exhaustive for `scripts/*.mjs` with a bare `--self-test` -- every one is chained there rather than excluded; a script whose cases are a vitest file (`check-third-party.mjs`, `check-workflows.mjs`, `verify-ffmpeg.mjs`) is covered by the unit suite instead. The unit suite is in the chain because the gate list carried no test run at all and a task closed with `vitest run` red (vg-323). `design:check` is in the chain for that same reason: it ran only as its own CI step, so a local `npm run gate` read green over a red live-tree verdict (vg-435). `typecheck` is the third of that family: vitest transpiles without typechecking, so at `f790b77d` a commit landed with `npm run typecheck` exit 1 and every gate step it did run green (vg-455). `docs:check` is the fourth and is a new check rather than a missing step: nothing resolved a reference into `docs/superpowers/plans/`, so a reference pointing at the right name in the wrong place made a reader conclude the plan was deleted (vg-434, decision 0048).  `scratch:check` is the fifth and is likewise new: the tree held 264 MB of scratch outside it and 13 MB of gitignored residue inside, and nothing in the loop said where scratch may go or walked for it (decision 0081). `third-party:check` is the sixth: `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` had drifted from the installed tree and nothing compared the inventory to the lockfile and the installed manifests. `workflows:check` is the seventh: a mutable action tag on the publish-capable workflows was the supply-chain hole this gate exists to close, and `publish.yml`'s install/publish privilege split is checked with it. `ffmpeg:check` is the eighth and closes the other downloaded executable: `ffmpeg-static`'s install fetches a platform binary that npm's tarball integrity does not cover, and the host spawns it, so the gate now compares it to the recorded digest before any re-encode would accept it. Fastest first, so the 1.5s design check and the 5s typecheck fail before the unit suite starts.
scripts.gates:self-test: node ../../scripts/reuse-gate.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/ownership-sweep.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/ownership-overlap.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/backlog-check.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/design-tokens.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/design-md.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/dead-code-sweep.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/ownership-enforcement.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/check-doc-references.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/capture-freshness.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/dead-selectors.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/oversize-files.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/scratch-gate.mjs --self-test && node ../../scripts/audit-policy.mjs --self-test

//devDependencies: jsdom and canvas are the `*.dom.test.ts` environment, declared here beside vitest because vitest.config.ts owns `environment` for the whole workspace. They were reachable without being declared — both are OPTIONAL dependencies of fabric@7.4.0 — which is the problem: `canvas` is native, npm continues silently when its prebuild is unavailable, and the tests that need a real 2D context would then lose it without failing. Declaring them also puts them through CI's licence job.
//overrides: Targeted transitive advisories (plan 2026-10-25 performance-and-security hardening, Task 8.3). Each override is kept only while the suite that exercises it is green; `docs/engineering/dependencies.md` records the measurement. `zod`'s lift keeps one scoped exception for `@google/design.md`, the dev-only linter that declares zod ^3. A jsdom override to 30 was tried and removed: it changed CSSStyleDeclaration serialisation and DOM removal semantics, failing 8 editor DOM cases.
